selected_evidence.requirement: Configure node1 to synchronize with pool.ntp.org
selected_evidence.summary: The persistent configuration contains `pool pool.ntp.org iburst`, validates successfully, and the clock reached synchronized state with a selected source.
chronyd is enabled and active. After reboot, NTPSynchronized=yes, Leap status is Normal, and current-boot logs explicitly show sources selected from pool.ntp.org.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 6001d24d-a752-4a58-a0b2-082876564497; the safe reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID is 25163d56-9ba0-4781-8675-ec2f8f6f8fd0; post-restart service, configuration, and synchronization assertions passed.
